newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy employers see 1996 PSBR at 125-130 trln lire.
newsitem.headline: Italy employers see 1996 PSBR at 125-130 trln lire.

text.p: Italy's public sector borrowing requirement for 1996 is heading for 125-130 trillion lire despite this summer's 16 trillion lire mini-budget, the research office of employers body Confindustria said.
The government's has set a PSBR target for this year of 113 trillion lire.
Latest Treasury figures show the cumulative PSBR at end-June at 52.250 trillion lire against 49.382 trillion in June 1995.

Confindustria said in its latest economic report, "budget policy over the last two years, with this year's budget and June's corrective measures, has not been sufficient to reach planned objectives and for this year the state sector borrowing requirement is heading for 125 to 130 trillion lire."
